program_goals.primary_goal: Help people with criminal records understand their record-clearing options and move from uncertainty to a clear next step. The program should help eligible participants complete guided screening, prepare the correct record-clearing documents when supported, and connect people to additional legal help when their situation requires an attorney.
program_goals.current_workflow: People learn about the program through Fresh Start Network outreach, community partners, clinics, events, and referrals. Participants enter through the Fresh Start Network/LegalEase program page and complete a guided record-clearing screening on their own or with staff assistance. The platform helps them understand their result and next steps in plain language. When a supported self-help path is available, the participant can continue through the information and verification process needed to prepare their record-clearing packet. When a matter requires legal representation, a hearing, or another issue outside the self-help process, the participant is directed to the appropriate legal-aid or attorney referral path. Fresh Start Network staff use program reporting to understand participation, packet generation, follow-up needs, and where participants are encountering barriers.
outreach_channels: Workforce, reentry, and legal-aid partner referrals
program_goals.target_population: People with criminal records who may be interested in clearing, sealing, or otherwise addressing eligible records, especially individuals who face barriers to employment, housing, education, licensing, or other opportunities because of their record. The program is intended to reach people who need a simple, affordable way to understand their options and next steps, including those who may need referral to legal aid or an attorney when self-help is not appropriate.
program_goals.definition_of_success: Success means participants can complete the process without having to understand complicated legal language on their own. They receive a clear screening result, understand what they need to do next, and, when appropriate, can generate a complete record-clearing packet. Participants whose matters cannot be handled through self-help are clearly identified and directed to the appropriate legal-aid or attorney support. The program should also give Fresh Start Network a clear view of how many people are being served, how many packets are generated, and where participants need additional help.
program_goals.operator_authority_reference: LegalEase operates this program under its own internal business and publication authority.
program_goals.partner_side_outcome_tracking: Fresh Start Network will track participant outcomes that occur after the LegalEase process, including whether participants file their record-clearing documents, whether court relief is granted or denied when that information is available, referrals to legal aid or attorneys, follow-up assistance requested, and participant-reported barriers or needs. The program may also track longer-term outcomes reported by participants, such as improvements in employment, housing, licensing, education, or other opportunities. brand_public_page.participant_support_copy: Need help using the program? Fresh Start Network can assist with screening, required information, next steps, and referrals. If your situation requires legal advice or representation, we can help connect you with legal-aid or attorney resources. Please use approved support channels for any sensitive information.
brand_public_page.approved_organization_description: Fresh Start Network helps people understand and navigate opportunities to move forward after involvement with the criminal legal system. Through this program, participants can explore record-clearing options, receive plain-language guidance, and connect with additional support when their situation requires legal assistance.

staff_dashboard_plan.access_review_frequency: Quarterly, and whenever a staff member leaves, changes roles, or no longer needs access. Access should also be reviewed immediately after any suspected security or privacy incident.

support_referrals_reporting.reporting_cadence: Monthly operational reporting with a quarterly impact review.
data_use_restrictions: Participant-level information may be used only for program administration, support, and authorized follow-up.
External reports should use aggregate or de-identified information unless participant-level disclosure is specifically authorized.
Sensitive case information should not be shared outside the approved program workflow without an authorized purpose.
Participant information may not be sold or used for unrelated marketing.
A screening result or generated packet must not be reported as a successful court outcome.
Access to participant information should be limited to authorized staff with a program need.
support_referrals_reporting.privacy_request_route: Participants or staff may raise a privacy request through the program’s designated support or privacy contact. The request should be documented, routed to the designated privacy owner, and reviewed before any disclosure, correction, access, or deletion action is taken. Sensitive information should not be sent through ordinary email unless specifically requested through an approved secure process.
funder_required_metrics: Participants referred or escalated for additional assistance
support_referrals_reporting.referral_intake_details: When a matter requires legal advice, representation, a contested hearing, or falls outside the supported self-help process, the self-help workflow stops. The participant will be directed to appropriate legal-aid, lawyer-referral, or other qualified legal-services resources based on jurisdiction. Fresh Start Network will not transmit participant information to another organization without an approved referral process and appropriate participant consent. A standing referral relationship should be established where practical before full program launch.
support_referrals_reporting.contested_matter_procedure: If a prosecutor objects, a contested hearing is scheduled, or individualized legal advice or representation is required, the self-help process stops. Program staff must not provide legal advice, advocate for the participant, or continue preparing the matter beyond the supported self-help scope. The participant will be informed that their matter requires assistance outside this program and that they may choose to seek independent legal counsel. This program does not make or endorse legal referrals unless a separate referral arrangement has been approved.
support_referrals_reporting.referral_response_expectation: Not applicable until a referral organization is designated.
support_referrals_reporting.external_outcome_data_description: Fresh Start Network may collect voluntary follow-up information from participants about filing status, court outcomes when known, legal-assistance needs, referrals, and participant-reported changes in employment, housing, licensing, education, or other opportunities. External outcome information may come from participant follow-up, partner records, or other authorized sources. Self-reported or unverified outcomes will be identified as such and will not be presented as verified court results.
support_referrals_reporting.media_inquiry_response_expectation: Acknowledge media inquiries within one business day. Only the designated media contact may provide an official response on behalf of the program.
support_referrals_reporting.legal_services_referral_organization: No designated referral organization yet — referral network to be finalized before launch
support_referrals_reporting.contested_matter_response_expectation: Review and respond within one business day, or as soon as reasonably possible when a court deadline or hearing is involved.
support_referrals_reporting.participant_support_response_expectation: Respond within one business day. Urgent privacy or security concerns should be escalated as soon as possible.

geography_audience_language_accessibilit.population_restrictions: No additional program-specific population restrictions. The program is intended to serve adults seeking information and assistance related to criminal-record clearing. Legal eligibility, available remedies, and case-specific limitations are determined separately through the LegalEase screening process and applicable law.
geography_audience_language_accessibilit.accessibility_accommodations: Participants may need plain-language instructions, Spanish-language support, screen-reader compatible content, keyboard-accessible navigation, large-text or zoom support, staff-assisted completion for people with limited digital literacy, and reasonable accommodations for participants with disabilities. When in-person services are offered, accessible locations and accommodations should be available upon request. Participants who cannot complete the process independently should be able to receive staff assistance without changing the legal screening rules.
